source.caption: Examples of sentence augmentation across different methods. Figure 2 showcases the application of the various methods on a sample sentence from the original dataset: “y/s drK .hd/sh l.tpl bb‘yyt hytw/sym wl’ t’mynw kmh zh p/sw.t wb.tw.h” (There is a new way to treat the mosquito problem and you won’t believe how simple and safe it is).
